name: Miyazawa Moe
source:
Hiro's classmate and student of Syouba High School. She is very determined and didn’t like relying on others, and also didn’t trust anyone else. Had relatively mature thinking, and was very sentimental. Had good grades, was skilled at drawing, and enjoyed reading. 

[spoiler]She was bullied at Sanae Girls’ High School, so after taking a year off from school, she transferred to Syouba High School.[/spoiler]
